FAIL_TO_PASS: return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
class-method-access: tracks side-effects when accessing class methods
object-literal-property-overwrites: detect side-effects in overwritten properties of object literals
this-in-class-body: uses the correct "this" value in class properties
early-access-getter-return: handles accessing the return expression of a getter before it has been bound
side-effects-object-literal-calls: detects side-effects when mutating object literals
array-expression: Tree-shake known array prototype functions
destructured-known-arguments: tracks known argument values through destructuring
side-effect-free-array-expression: Tree-shakes side-effect-free array functions if only their return value is unused
static-class-property-calls: handles effects when calling static class properties
no-default-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments by default
recursive-calls: do not fail for recursive calls
literals-from-class-statics: tracks literal values in class static fields
super-class-prototype-calls: correctly resolves the prototype of the super class when calling properties
conditional-expression-paths: only retain branches with side-effects
return-expressions: Track side-effects of method return values
no-global-call-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of calls to globals by default
track-destructured-setter: tracks side effects from setters in destructuring assignments

supports-es5-shim: supports es5-shim
